job_title: Technical Lead, R&D Software Engineer – Medical
job_description: Philips is seeking an R&D Software Development Engineer in Orange, OH. This role is focused on defining software quality goals, integrating software solutions, conducting code reviews, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Candidates should have a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science with at least 3 years of experience (or none with a Master’s). The position offers a competitive salary range of $114,750 to $183,600, with additional benefits including annual incentive bonus and comprehensive rewards program.
